headline: Financing conditions tightened further: high-yield spreads blew out to about 376 bp on Friday (up 53 bp in a week) and the dollar hit a 19-month high near 104.3, while futures still price a roughly 90%+ chance of a +25 bp hike on Dec 9. Keep hurdle rates anchored to a ~4.9% 10-year plus 25–50 bp of expected policy tightening, and budget materially wider spreads on any new levered or high-yield financing. The one relief is energy, with WTI near $80 and Brent below $90, which eases input-cost assumptions.
